a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating first will most likely leave us both dead, so I plan to take 4 in round 1 instead of following the agreement. I won't hide it. Once my unit is full I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
